checkedAlternates.risk: Sucralose is derived chemically from sucrose.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Sucralose is a chlorinated high-intensity synthetic sweetener (~600x sweeter, group-1), not a sugar alcohol polyol (group-3).

checkedAlternates.risk: Coconut palm sugar comes from palm flower sap.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Coconut palm sugar is sold as a granulated/block sucrose sugar (group-4), unlike tapped deciduous tree-trunk syrups (group-2).
